irons_spellbooks:furled_map.dimension_fa.name: This map does not lead to anything in this dimension.

irons_spellbooks:archevoker_log.page_1.name: We arrived at the location He sent us to just before last dusk, a march of many days. One last time, we slept on the dirt; this morning we rose with purpose anew, beginning to etch a barrier of logs and home of stone.

irons_spellbooks:archevoker_log.page_2.name: Construction is near complete. As I write, supplies make their way into our hospice - freshly hewn wood from the area, a shipment of glass from fort greater. Discovery awaits.

irons_spellbooks:archevoker_log.page_3.name: I had never thought it possible, this magic seems to be messing with my mind. I swear there used to be a cellar below the chapel, yet even my second in command says it were never so... Surely I cannot be the one going mad?

irons_spellbooks:archevoker_log.page_4.name: Scouts have returned with fantastic news, that of a village, and not too far to return the supplies here with ease after laying siege. However, magical research in this area seems to be inconclusive. We may be abandoning soon.

irons_spellbooks:archevoker_log.entry_1..name: We reached the location to which He bade us journey, a laborious march spanning many days. As the sun surrendered to dusk, we rested our wearied bodies upon the earth for what I trust to be the final time. This morn,
we rose with purpose anew, and began to etch a barrier of logs and home of stone.

irons_spellbooks:archevoker_log.entry_2..name: Our construction draws nigh its completion. As I pen these very words, the final shipment of supplies flow into our haven - enough timber, freshly hewn from the surrounding wilds, to finish the enclosure, and panes of glass
sent from Fort Greater. Soon shall the research commence, the likes of which may yet shake the pillars of the world.

irons_spellbooks:archevoker_log.entry_3..name: A strange unease takes root within my mind. This magic - though wondrous - doth twist the senses. I could have sworn there was a cellar beneath the chapel's floor, and yet now none recall it. Even my most trusted lieutenant
claims such a thing never was. Am I alone in this delusion? Has madness begun to gnaw at me?

irons_spellbooks:archevoker_log.entry_4..name: Our scouts return with tidings of a village, not far from our encampment. This is good news, for supplies dwindle. We shall lay siege and easily procure what is needed, for the distance is not great.
However, the magical research in these lands proves troublesome - few are the answers we seek. It may soon come to pass that we abandon this place, move to the next site.

irons_spellbooks:energized_core.failure.name: A calm sky holds no power; the core remains inert
